content: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order, please.
Sure, what would you like to order?
I would like to order two chicken biryanis for delivery. Do you have those available, and what is the price? Also, could you please make them less spicy if possible?
Sorry, chicken biryanis are sold out today. Would you like to order prawn biryani instead?
No thank you, I do not eat seafood. Do you have chicken pulao or chicken karahi instead?
Sorry, chicken karahi and chicken pulao are also sold out today. Would you like to order raita instead?
Ah, no thank you. Do you have any other chicken items available?
Sorry, all chicken items are sold out today. Would you like to order something else?

arguments.reason: No suitable items available within the brief.
